title: Anticogging: Torque ripple suppression, modeling, and parameter selection
publisher: SAGE, The International Journal of Robotics Research
author: Matthew Piccoli; Mark Yim
locator: Torque ripple taxonomy and position-indexed anticogging compensation concept
notes: Research article separates mutual, reluctance, cogging and friction torque components and discusses position-indexed compensation. Its demonstrated systems and parameter values are not universal CNC axis specifications.
